about: SHARD-PLATFORM SP4 (Jake, 2026-10-03: exempt now, fix in P5): levels whose edges can't carry the walkable 15 m road MMO-REQUIREMENTS W4 asks for. May only shrink; each entry names the row that adds its edge entries.

levels.driftwood-isle: open sea at every edge: SP22 adds a pier or sandbar road at each midpoint
levels.far-reach: floating islands, no ground at the edges: SP23 adds a bridge or landing isle at each midpoint
